description: This file contains unit tests for verifying grain state persistence in an Orleans-based distributed system. It tests that grain state survives deactivation and reactivation cycles, ensuring durability without explicit database code.

classes.name: StateClassTests
classes.description: A test class that verifies the persistence and durability of grain state across activation cycles in Orleans.

methods.name: StateClassTests_StateClass
methods.description: A test method that verifies basic state persistence by setting a value, deactivating, reactivating, and checking if the value persists.

methods.name: StateClassTests_Test
methods.description: A helper method that performs the core logic of setting a grain state, deactivating, reactivating, and verifying the state persists.
